## lamina

- **Views in tabs and splits.** lamina holds several views at once: other files, a second view of the same file, every sheet of a workbook. Each tab has its own filter, sort, calcs and grid, and views never read each other. Opening a file adds a tab; re-reading it replaces the view in place.
- **The raw view.** A file's lines as the bytes have them, with byte offsets, the invisible characters made visible, a grep-able cursor and hex. It sits beside the table: *Show raw* goes from a row to its line, *Show as a row* comes back.
- **Lens v2.** One `.lamina` file saves the sources, views and layout, from a single reading up to a whole session. When a file can't be found, a dialog asks for it. Recent files bring their last views back, and the empty page offers your last session. v1 lenses still open.
- **Pinned results.** An instrument window (Group by, data quality, a profile…) pins as a result tab. It says when its view has changed since, and *run again* refreshes it.
- **The interpretation pane** shows a file's first lines next to its options, and the decimal separator can be auto, point or comma.
- **Data quality** says where each flagged value first appears, and *complement view* opens what a filter left out.
- **Fixes found while writing the manual:** a `.dm` inside an archive, the ≈ median, float32 noise in Datamine single-precision files, the decimal comma, the thousands separator, Group by's first value, and others.

## lamina, DD-60 edition

An easter egg at [gentropic.org/lamina/dd60](https://gentropic.org/lamina/dd60/): the GCU DD-60 "DADA Diskman", reading files of any size as lamina does. FILTER · GO TO · RAW · STATS · MENU, a d-pad, keys you can type on, and a layout that works on a phone. Networkless (`connect-src 'none'`).
